description: The contract between the three prompt personas and the orchestration layer. The prompts describe these artifacts, src/eval/prompt-contracts.eval.ts asserts they still do, and agent/local/continue.sh reads these paths. One source of truth so the three cannot drift apart.

plan.required_on_failure: no plan artifact means the run aborts before the executor starts

run_summary.required_on_failure: no run summary means the wrapper falls back to PROGRESS.md and opens the pull request with a degraded body

validation.required_on_failure: no validation artifact is treated as a fail verdict; the run does not open a pull request
